feature.label: General SEM PLS Single-Mediation Full-Model Case Bootstrap

claim.supported_scope: Exactly one discovered substantive indirect path in a recursive, single-group composite PLS model with indexed full-model case bootstrap and two-sided percentile Type-7 inference.
claim.estimand: The product of the ordered path coefficients for the one eligible indirect path, together with its aggregate total-indirect and total effects, recomputed after a complete model refit in each usable case-bootstrap replicate.
assumptions: Exactly one indirect path is discovered from substantive directed structural relations; covariance, control, measurement, generated and hierarchy relations are excluded.
The model is a recursive single-group composite PLS model with raw numeric data, listwise deletion, no weights, no interactions and no higher-order construct.
Replicate indices, replacement sampling, percentile Type-7 intervals and the usable-replicate threshold follow the frozen General SEM bootstrap convention.
exclusions: Two or more eligible indirect paths route to the historical multiple-mediation bootstrap identity and are not relabelled by this cell.
Causal and counterfactual mediation claims, cycles, moderated mediation, observed-variable PROCESS, groups, weights, clusters and non-listwise handling are excluded.
BCa, studentized and one-sided intervals are excluded.
warnings: This exact bounded cell is scoped Standard under quickpls_v253_streamlined_integration_v1; all exclusions and corrective fail-closed behavior remain in force.
SmartPLS documentation is used only as a terminology and observable-workflow benchmark; QuickPLS is independently implemented.

equations.expression: indirect_p = product(beta_e for e in ordered_path_p)

references.citation: MacKinnon (2008), Introduction to Statistical Mediation Analysis
QuickPLS 2.53 validation-only single-path and three-way compact reference matrix

simulations.design: A compact deterministic recursive X-to-M-to-Y fixture with signal, null, row-reorder, fixed-replicate replay and one failed-fit boundary; production and independent implementations consume the same indexed resample rows.
simulations.seed_policy: Frozen scenario seed and explicit replicate-index streams; failed fits remain in the shared ledger.
simulations.acceptance_rule: Point, every usable replayed replicate and interval agree within 1e-10; ledger and worker replay identities agree exactly.

boundaries.case: A resample makes a required stage constant, nonfinite or singular.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Record one typed failed replicate, continue the indexed traversal and publish only if the shared usable threshold passes.

boundaries.case: The model has zero or more than one eligible indirect path, or an interaction or HOC term.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Route to the correct other cell or return one corrective blocked decision without modifying the model.

boundaries.case: Rows or declarations are consistently reordered.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Mapped scientific identities and values remain equivalent under the frozen indexing convention.

boundaries.case: The same model, data, seed, replicate count and worker count are rerun.
boundaries.expected_behavior: The scientific payload is identical apart from operational identifiers and timestamps.

boundaries.case: A path identity, coefficient, interval, ledger, method version or capability cell is altered.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Strict validation rejects the archive and exposes no changed completed result.

tamper_tests.expected_behavior: Reject a result whose single-mediation capability differs from its compiled authority.
Reject a result relabelled with the multiple-mediation or another bootstrap method version.
Reject a result whose resident dataset fingerprint differs.
Reject a changed archive member or canonical attachment digest.
Reject duplicate keys, nonfinite values, broken path mappings or incoherent bootstrap ledgers.
Never reinterpret a historical multiple-path result as this new exact identity.

persistence.legacy_policy: Older mediation results keep their original capability and method identities; this cell applies only to a newly executed exactly-one-path general_sem_v1 run.

native.gui_cli_parity_rule: For the same resident authority, data fingerprint, seed and recipe, every surface reads the same canonical point, interval, ledger and identity.
accessibility_rules: Mediation requires no pointer-only node and is discoverable from ordinary paths.
Path, interval, failure and unavailable details are available in accessible text and tables.
